gestures.name: explain
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and talks with both hands, moving them in front of the chest and opening the palms outward.

gestures.name: laugh
gestures.prompt: A person giggles, covering the mouth with one hand, the shoulders shaking.

gestures.name: yawn
gestures.prompt: A person stretches both arms high above the head, then lowers them slowly to the sides.

gestures.name: stretch
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place, interlocks the fingers, stretches both arms forward and then straight up, and relaxes.

gestures.name: dance
gestures.prompt: A person dances happily in place, swaying the hips side to side and moving both arms to the rhythm.

gestures.name: look_around
gestures.prompt: A person stands still and turns the head to the left, then to the right, looking around, then faces forward again.

gestures.name: sigh
gestures.prompt: A tired person sighs: the shoulders rise with a slow breath in, then drop as they breathe out, the head nodding down slightly.

gestures.name: excited
gestures.prompt: A person bounces on the toes in place and shakes both fists quickly in front of the chest.

gestures.name: salute
gestures.prompt: A person stands straight and raises the right hand to the forehead in a military salute, then lowers it.

gestures.name: fist_pump
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and pumps the right fist up in the air twice.

gestures.name: stop
gestures.prompt: A person extends the right arm straight forward at chest height with the palm facing forward to signal stop, holds it, then lowers it.

gestures.name: come_here
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and beckons with the right hand, waving it toward the body several times.

gestures.name: scratch_head
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place, raises the right hand and scratches the back of the head, then lowers the hand.

gestures.name: hands_on_hips
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and puts both hands on the hips, leaning slightly forward.

gestures.name: shiver
gestures.prompt: A person feels cold, wraps both arms around the chest hugging themselves and shivers, rubbing the upper arms with the hands.

gestures.name: air_guitar
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place playing air guitar, strumming quickly with the right hand while the left hand holds the neck of the guitar out to the side.

gestures.name: shy
gestures.prompt: A person stands with the hands clasped behind the back, sways gently side to side and lowers the head.

gestures.name: sneeze
gestures.prompt: A person tilts the head back, then jerks the head and torso forward in a sneeze, covering the mouth with the right hand.

gestures.name: dab
gestures.prompt: A person does a dab: the head dips into the bent left elbow while the right arm extends straight up and out to the side, then returns.

gestures.name: point_self
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and points at their own chest with the right index finger, then lowers the hand.

enter.prompt: A person stands with their back to a high table, puts both hands on its edge behind the hips, pushes up with the arms and sits on the edge of the table.

loop.prompt: A person sits on the edge of a high table with both hands on the edge beside the hips, the legs dangling and gently swinging.

exit.prompt: A person sitting on the edge of a high table slides off, lands on their feet and stands up straight.

enter.prompt: A person steps forward and bends toward something right in front of their face, peering at it very closely.

loop.prompt: A person leans forward, peering very closely at something right in front of their face, slowly tilting the head from side to side.

exit.prompt: A person who was leaning forward to look closely at something straightens up and steps back.

enter.prompt: A person kneels down and lies on their stomach on the floor, propping themselves up on the elbows.

loop.prompt: A person lies on their stomach propped up on the elbows, holding a book with both hands and reading, the lower legs raised and swinging back and forth.

exit.prompt: A person gets up from the floor to a standing position.

enter.prompt: A tired person sits down on the floor and lies down on their back to sleep.

loop.prompt: A person sleeps lying on their back on the floor, breathing slowly and shifting slightly.

exit.prompt: A frightened person lying on their back wakes up with a start and quickly jumps up to their feet.

enter.prompt: A person starts to walk forward slowly, lifting the knees high with each step, the hands clasped behind the back.

loop.prompt: A person walks forward slowly and playfully, lifting the knees high with each step, the hands clasped behind the back.

exit.prompt: A person walking with high knees and the hands clasped behind the back slows down and stops.

enter.prompt: A person sits down on a chair at a desk and leans forward, resting both forearms on the desk.

loop.prompt: A sleepy person sitting at a desk rests the chin on one fist with the elbow on the desk, the head upright; the head slowly slips off the hand, they wake with a small jerk and rest the chin on the fist again.

exit.prompt: A person sitting at a desk with the forearms on it sits up straight and stands up.
